correctness.rationale: At a point of an arbitrary chain, exact fusion membership and downward-existence indicators obey two identities established by the maximum witness equivalence; the union identities hold trivially. Structural induction reduces every signed formula to 2k signed atomic (E,H) pairs, each E<=H and hence one of three values. All independent three-value assignments are realized at the top of the 2-chain, proving bidirectional equivalence for arbitrary finite Boolean combinations of signed local requirements, and 9^k effective evaluation. Explicit absorption on one point and failure on 2 points proves optimality. Incomparable a,b joining to c proves the exact chain boundary. The included independent finite checker directly cross-checks set semantics, recurrences and witnesses but is not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: A direct and uniform two-state theorem for the full non-inclusive bilateral propositional truthmaker language on all chains was not located in the inspected primary text, accessible prior records or actual semantic searches. The closest general antecedent (Knudstorp 2023) proves a finite-model property and decidability on general semilattices but its displayed construction does not assert the formula-independent two-state chain bound. The present quantitative sharp specialization, the signed three-profile calculus and the exact 3-state nonchain obstruction are not immediate statements of those results. This is a best-knowledge originality assessment rather than proof of priority; see risks.
residual_risks: A prior analysis restricted to linearly ordered truthmaker frames, including an uninspected theorem or corollary in older proof-theoretic literature, could subsume this uniform bound. The accessible full text of Fine and Jago (2019) was not inspected.
The direct chain recurrence is elementary once non-inclusive semantics are fixed, so priority as an unpublished folklore lemma cannot be excluded by negative literature searches.
Accessible published records and primary sources cannot by themselves establish priority; older and unindexed work may alter the originality assessment.

value.rationale: The recent semantics-to-modal translation programme motivates whether full exact fusion still requires complicated states on the especially natural linearly ordered information domain. The result identifies the exact complete local signed semantic invariants (three possibilities per atom per sign), replaces general formula-dependent finite-model search by a uniform optimal 2-state decision test, and locates the first structural obstruction at a 3-state fork. It is a natural complete fragment classification and sharp finite-model boundary, not a cosmetic normalization, arbitrary parameter substitution or known table recomputation.
